title: No real teacher: help from Joe Welch and Manuel Manetta
summary: Dawson says he taught himself but needed a teacher for note divisions, and got help from Joe Welch and Manetta.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear
